concept.title: Oasis Sundown Rush
concept.logline: On sand-scoured, mysterious Wynashdune, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Minaret of the Flats.
concept.source_prompt: Oasis Flats. oasis bazaar mirage flats mission Timed rush
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Palm Spring Bazaar and becomes the one who brings the Minaret of the Flats back to life.

key_locations.name: Palm Spring Bazaar
key_locations.description: The start: Palm Spring Bazaar, where every trail of the compact trail begins.

key_locations.name: Date Palm Oasis
key_locations.description: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Palm Spring Bazaar.

key_locations.name: Buried Palace
key_locations.description: Buried Palace: a ruin on the way out from Palm Spring Bazaar.

key_locations.name: Minaret of the Flats
key_locations.description: Minaret of the Flats: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Caravan Master Nadia
characters.description: Waits in Palm Spring Bazaar and knows why the Minaret of the Flats fell silent.

characters.name: Wren the Guide
characters.description: Follows you from Palm Spring Bazaar and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Dune Stalker
characters.description: A dune stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Hale the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Wynashdune for anything shiny.

characters.name: Sand Hopper
characters.description: A harmless sand hopper that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Light the finale before the clock runs out
hazards: Sandstorm sweeping the exposed ground around the Minaret of the Flats

actions.value: On sand-scoured, mysterious Wynashdune, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Minaret of the Flats.
The clock is already running. Hit every site, then light the finale.
Split: the Buried Palace. Keep going!
Split: the Date Palm Oasis. Keep going!

You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: So you've come to Palm Spring Bazaar at last. I am Caravan Master Nadia. On sand-scoured, mysterious Wynashdune, you race to recover the sun shards and restore the Minaret of the Flats.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Back again. Palm Spring Bazaar is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Go to Date Palm Oasis, then Buried Palace. Whatever still remembers Oasis Sundown Rush is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Palm Spring Bazaar, Oasis Sundown Rush was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Peaceful, even then.

choices.text: Tell me about Date Palm Oasis.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Date Palm Oasis: Date Palm Oasis: a grove on the way out from Palm Spring Bazaar.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Oasis Sundown Rush back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Caravan Master Nadia
nodes.text: Buried Palace: Buried Palace: a ruin on the way out from Palm Spring Bazaar.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Guide
nodes.text: Wren the Guide circles your feet, then looks toward Minaret of the Flats as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Guide
nodes.text: Wren the Guide sniffs the air. Something about Minaret of the Flats has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Wren the Guide
nodes.text: It turns toward Minaret of the Flats. Minaret of the Flats: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Dune Stalker
nodes.text: The dune stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Palm Spring Bazaar. Hale the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Oasis Sundown Rush that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Hale the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Buried Palace after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Sand Hopper
nodes.text: The sand hopper freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
